HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

5. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   B. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   C. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
